response_raw:
HouseScenario
agents:
	humans: Human
	robots: Robot
locations: bedroom, kitchen
resources: object

Robot:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	2: pick object
	3: moveTo kitchen

Human:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	2: restart all if !possess(Robot, object)
	3: moveTo kitchen

success: position(Robot, kitchen) && position(Human, kitchen) && possess(Robot, object)
failure: !position(Robot, kitchen) || !position(Human, kitchen) || !possess(Robot, object)
